notes.title: First version funded, finished, and so much fun!
notes.notes: The first version of Beer Pong VR is now online and ready for purchase. If you think this version is fun we have more coming for you in the fun category. We are working on the online multi player head to head version so you can play with your college friends and make new firends around the country and possibly the world very soon! Thanks to everyone who helped us to finish our goal on Kickstarter and now allow us to amaze you and your friends. Enjoy the experience and make sure you do not lay your controllers on the table, it is virtual.....
